explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/976: for irreducible f ∈ ℤ[x] of degree d ≥ 2 and F_f(n) the greatest prime divisor of ∏_{m ≤ n} f(m), 'Or even ≫ n^d?' The Lean statement: for every irreducible f with natDegree ≥ 2, n^d = O(F f n), with F f n = maxPrimeFac |∏_{1≤m≤n} f(m)| (nonzero since an irreducible polynomial of degree ≥ 2 has no integer roots). This is the standard encoding of F_f(n) ≫ n^d (constant depending on f); note F_f(n) ≤ max |f(m)| ≪ n^d, so this asks whether the trivial upper bound is attained up to constants. Faithful (positive form of the yes/no question).
